TigerGraph graph algorithm (GDS weakly connected components, tg_wcc) over the Nov–Dec graph of cards-in-use and rare device profiles puts this payment's device in a connected component of 10 cards (11 card fingerprints, 3 device profiles). Context only: it does not change the fraud probability

Retrieved guidance applied: Card-not-present fraud from a new device: as card-not-present fraud, with the identity record marking the device as New for this account, sometimes behind a proxy. Stronger than plain CNP but not proof, since people buy new phones.

case.summary: The case was opened after a portfolio sweep flagged a new device profile on card C00483-K1. Evidence showed the cardholder had a long history of small, consistent purchases on the same device, indicating legitimate use. The new device profile was the only adverse signal, and the fraud probability was 0.04, below the 0.15 threshold. The investigation concluded the transaction was legitimate, the card was not blocked, and the case was closed as legitimate.
